nodes.label: Growra (Gamified Task Management App)
nodes.rationale: Based on self-accountability rather than external validation; completing real-life tasks gives rewards, rewards progress pets and unlock content, and consistency increases efficiency through streak bonuses.

nodes.label: Tech Direction (React Native + Expo, TypeScript)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for fast iteration on a real device via QR code, mobile-first development, reduced setup complexity, and suitability for an MVP.

nodes.label: Fusion System
nodes.rationale: Selling a max-fused pet (4 fusions) yields pity coins instead of regular coins, rewarding investment in duplicates without breaking economy balance.

nodes.label: Adventure System
nodes.rationale: Gives value to otherwise inactive pets without generating coins or replacing the core task system, keeping task completion as the only source of real progression.

nodes.label: Economy System
nodes.rationale: Systems that bypass effort or provide streak protection are explicitly disallowed, preserving the requirement that real-world action drives progression.

nodes.label: Pity Shop
nodes.rationale: Combines randomness with guaranteed progression, giving players a way to manage excess duplicate pets.

nodes.label: Architecture Principles
nodes.rationale: Separate concerns (tasks, pets, rewards), keep logic modular, avoid unnecessary abstraction early, avoid defensive programming, assume valid typed data.

nodes.label: Coding Rules
nodes.rationale: Use TypeScript strictly, avoid any, avoid runtime type checks, trust defined interfaces, keep functions simple and readable.

nodes.label: Key Design Principle
nodes.rationale: The app must never allow passive progression to replace real-world action; users must always complete tasks, stay consistent, and engage actively.
